evidence.quote:
one bundle per run per person, not one
> message per skill
one thing to read, not four

observations.why: Matched parallel clauses setting up direct numerical antitheses ('one... not one', 'one... not four') to enforce a delivery rule.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the rule or boundary framed through symmetrical 'X, not Y' contrastive clauses?
